== Summary ==
'''CardMaker recreation''' of [[Rycar Ryjerd (V) (Errata)]] (<code>1210_136</code>, Virtual Block 1 slip 137), showing the '''PC-E1''' game text. Re-rendered in CardMaker: no published image of this text.

* '''Text source:''' Players Committee forum, “Current Rulings/Errata” (t=36574), post p874174 by Lukes Bionic Hand, 27 March 2014: https://forum.starwarsccg.org/viewtopic.php?t=36574&start=40#p874174
* '''PC-E1 text:''' “Deploy on table. If your character is about to be lost from table, each player may place all their devices and Effects on that character in their Used Pile. Twice per game, may ▲ a device (or Effect) that deploys on a character. (Immune to Alter.)”
* '''Made:''' 11 November 2026 with the SWCCG CardMaker (https://swccg.com/cardmaker/, repo billbisco/swccg-cardmaker, STANDARD rev 74) from the card's own Virtual Legacy card, with the PC-E1 game text. Holotable size, 745 × 1039. Rebuild spec: <code>VB1-137-Rycar_Ryjerd-PC-E1-cardmaker.png.spec.json</code> in the batch B41 run folder.
* '''Not an official image.''' Card art and design © Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc.; virtual card text by the Star Wars CCG Players Committee.
